extractedWith: tools/extract/extract.ps1 -Batch p5-jobs -Manifest <scratch copy of allowlist.manifest.yaml with the p5-jobs batch> -Clean (staging %TEMP%/codelab-extract/p5-jobs, outside the repo; scrub findings are expected before the rewrite; secret scan clean)
promotion: Each staged file was read as a reference and rewritten with starter names and structure; "target" is the repo file it informed, "stagedTarget" the path in the staging folder. Content is a rewrite, so the repo file hash differs from stagedSha256. The source jobs and the role-bearing actor were not carried. The job failure log filter was harvested in phase 1 (Codelab.Observability JobFailureLogFilter) and is reused, not re-extracted.

origins.note: Rewritten as the kernel IJob port: Key, bilingual name and a nullable cron from constants, and RunAsync(JobRunContext) with no acting-user parameter; the description and display-only schedule strings were dropped (the cron is the schedule). The returned item count became a log line of the job.

Split into one use case per endpoint (ListJobs, TriggerJobRun, ListJobRuns) returning Outcome<T>/Refusal (404 JOBS_JOB_NOT_FOUND, 409 JOBS_RUN_IN_PROGRESS) instead of an outcome enum; the poll-one-run call became the run history list.

The summary/run projections became JobSummary and the wire records JobResponse/JobRunResponse with a PublicId run id, int enums (JobRunStatus Queued/Running/Succeeded/Failed, JobTrigger Schedule/Manual with explicit values) instead of enum names, the SYSTEM actor, triggeredBy and a reference code instead of an error text.

Kept the catalog-from-DI and the one-active-run guard (now bounded by JobsLimits.ActiveRunWindow so a lost run never locks a job out); a manual run is recorded Queued (not Running) with the caller subject, and a dispatch failure closes the row (JOBS_ENQUEUE_FAILED). Scheduled runs are recorded too (the source wrote rows for manual runs only).

Rewritten as HangfireJobRunDispatcher (IJobRunDispatcher) enqueuing HangfireJobEntry.RunManualAsync(runId); the same file adds the per-key distributed run lock and the stable Hangfire entry methods with AutomaticRetry 0.

The load-bearing catch and the classified code (never ex.Message) were kept; the seeded user acting in a clinical role was removed entirely: runs execute inside ISystemActorScope with actor SYSTEM, a fresh correlation scope and a reference code from Codelab.Observability; abandoned Running rows are closed, overlap is refused through the run lock, and cancellation of the node propagates (JobRunner holds the entry logic).

Read as the reference for the module docs: the flows, the gotchas (schema not EF-owned, static Hangfire state, arguments serialized by name) and the add-a-job recipe were rewritten for the starter; the dashboard, the per-request follow-up scheduling and the source jobs are not carried.
